founder_message: Chandigarh Civil Services was established in December 2020 with the intent to be a true counselor and logistics provider for youngsters aspiring a dream in Indian Civil Services and Provincial Civil Services Exams. It has a set plan to work on basics and to make students self-reliant and intrepid enough to hold challenges by horns. From the foundation programme to answer writing, a time-bound programme and result-oriented strategy have been visualised. Enrolled students will see a difference in approach in containing content and a change in their perception to deal with in academics.
